summary.text: Leah Halton-Pope is the Democratic candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 141, in the November 3, 2026 general election, for a seat with no incumbent.
She is a member of the Buffalo Common Council, representing the Ellicott District since January 1, 2024.

paragraphs.text: Leah Halton-Pope won the Democratic primary for the Buffalo Common Council's Ellicott District on June 27, 2023, defeating three other candidates with 46.1 percent of the vote.
She then won the November 7, 2023 general election with 77.8 percent of the vote, succeeding Darius Pridgen, and took office on January 1, 2024.
Her current Council term ends on December 31, 2027.
